level1.text: The turbine of a hydropower plant converts $92.0\,\%$ of the kinetic energy of the water into mechanical energy, and the generator converts $98.0\,\%$ of the energy of the turbine shaft into electricity. What is the efficiency of the whole plant? Give your answer as a percentage.

The power of the kinetic energy of the air flow swept by the rotor of a wind turbine is $2.50\,\text{MW}$, and the turbine delivers a power of $1.05\,\text{MW}$ to the electricity grid. What is the efficiency of the turbine? Give your answer as a percentage.

The area of a solar panel installed on a roof is $20.0\,\text{m}^2$, and sunlight hits it with a power of $1.00\,\text{kW}$ for every square metre. The efficiency of the panel is 0.210. How much electric power does the panel produce? Give your answer in kilowatts.

The figure shows the power of a condensing power plant at different steps of the energy chain: $P_0$ is the fuel power, $P_1$ the power after the boiler, $P_2$ the power after the steam cycle and $P_3$ the electric power. In which step does the power decrease the most, and how large is the power transferred to the surroundings as heat in this step? Read the values from the figure. Give your answer in megawatts.

The fuel power of a combined heat and power plant is $250\,\text{MW}$. The plant produces $75.0\,\text{MW}$ of electricity and $150\,\text{MW}$ of district heating. What is the overall efficiency of the plant? Give your answer as a percentage.

A condensing power plant and a combined heat and power plant burn the same amount of the same fuel. The overall efficiency of the combined heat and power plant is still clearly higher. What explains this?
level1.answer: The heat of the condenser is used as district heating, so a larger share of the energy is put to use.

choices.text: More energy is released when the fuel burns in combined production, so there is enough for both electricity and heat.
choices.feedback: The same fuel always releases the same energy, because the heat of combustion is a property of the substance. The difference comes from how large a share of the energy is put to use.

choices.text: In combined production the turbine converts a larger share of the heat into electricity, so less waste heat is left.
choices.feedback: A combined heat and power plant usually produces less electricity than a condensing power plant, because part of the energy of the steam stays as heat. The overall efficiency is higher because this heat is also used.

choices.text: The district heating network adds energy as the water circulates in the pipes, so more comes out than goes in.
choices.feedback: Energy is not created from nothing: the electricity and heat obtained cannot add up to more than the fuel power supplied, so $\eta_\text{tot} \leq 100\,\%$.

choices.text: The heat of the condenser is used as district heating, so a larger share of the energy is put to use.
choices.feedback: Correct: in a condensing power plant the heat of the condenser goes to the sea as waste heat. In combined production it warms the water of the district heating network, and the useful power is counted as $P_\text{s} + P_\text{k}$.

level1.text: The thermal power of the reactor of a nuclear power plant is $1500\,\text{MW}$, and the plant delivers electricity to the grid at a power of $510\,\text{MW}$. What is the efficiency of the plant's electricity production? Give your answer as a percentage.
The fuel power of a power plant is $500\,\text{MW}$, and the plant runs at a steady power for a day. How much fuel energy enters the plant in a day? Give your answer in gigawatt-hours.

level2.text: The fuel power of a peat-burning condensing power plant is $300\,\text{MW}$. The efficiency of the boiler is 0.880, of the steam cycle (turbine and condenser) 0.420 and of the generator 0.980. How large is the electric power of the plant? Give your answer in megawatts.

The efficiency of the whole energy chain of a condensing power plant is 0.380. The efficiency of the boiler is 0.900 and of the generator 0.980. What is the efficiency of the steam cycle, that is of the turbine and the condenser? Give your answer as a percentage.

A condensing power plant burning wood chips produces electricity at an average power of $150\,\text{MW}$, and the efficiency of the whole plant is 0.360. The heat of combustion of wood chips is $9.00\,\text{MJ/kg}$. How many tonnes of chips does the plant burn in an hour? Give your answer in tonnes.

Heat is transferred to the condenser of a coastal condensing power plant at a power of $270\,\text{MW}$. The sea water cooling the condenser warms up by $9.00\,\text{K}$. The specific heat capacity of water is $4190\,\text{J/(kg}\cdot\text{K)}$. How many tonnes of water flow through the condenser per second? Give your answer in tonnes per second.

A combined heat and power plant producing district heating and electricity records every year the energy bound in the fuel and the electricity and district heating it produces (table, example data). The year 2023 was cold.

a) Calculate the electrical efficiency $\eta_\text{s}$ for each year.

b) Calculate the overall efficiency $\eta_\text{tot}$ for each year.

c) Explain why the electrical efficiency decreased but the overall efficiency increased.

In part b), enter the overall efficiency of 2023 in the answer box as a percentage.

level2.text:
The table gives the fuel or reactor power $P_0$ and the electric power $P_\text{s}$ of three power plants (example data). All the plants are condensing power plants, and the rest of the energy is transferred to the surroundings as waste heat.

a) Calculate the efficiency of each plant.

b) Calculate the waste heat power $P_\text{h}$ of each plant.

c) Does the plant with the lowest efficiency also have the largest waste heat power? Justify your answer.

In part b), enter the largest waste heat power in the answer box in megawatts.

data.caption: Powers of three condensing power plants (example data)

level2.text:
The efficiency of the boiler of a condensing power plant is 0.920, of the steam cycle 0.410 and of the generator 0.970.

Student's solution: “The efficiencies are added together, because all the steps affect the result: $0.920 + 0.410 + 0.970 = 2.30$. So the efficiency of the plant is $230\,\%$.”

a) Explain why the student's solution is wrong.

b) Calculate the correct efficiency of the plant.

In part b), enter the result in the answer box as a percentage.

level3.text: The fuel power of a combined heat and power plant is $600\,\text{MW}$. When the plant produces only electricity, the electric power is $240\,\text{MW}$. When all the heat of the condenser is led into the district heating network, the electric power is $180\,\text{MW}$ and the district heating power $348\,\text{MW}$. Between these modes the electric power decreases linearly as the district heating power increases. The district heating network now needs $200\,\text{MW}$ of heat. How large is the electric power of the plant? Give your answer in megawatts. Also calculate the overall efficiency of the plant and justify why the combined efficiency of electricity and heat still does not tell which way of production is more worthwhile.

A wind farm produces $36.0\,\text{GWh}$ of electricity in a year ($1\,\text{GWh} = 3.60 \cdot 10^{12}\,\text{J}$). If the same electricity were produced with hard coal in a condensing power plant with an efficiency of 0.380 and where the heat of combustion of coal is $25.0\,\text{MJ/kg}$, how many kilotonnes of coal ($1\,\text{kt} = 10^{6}\,\text{kg}$) would be burned in a year? Also explain why the efficiency of a wind farm cannot be compared with the efficiency of a coal power plant as directly as those of two condensing power plants.

Heating a house takes $100\,\text{kWh}$ of heat. The electricity is produced in a condensing power plant with an efficiency of 0.400, and $5.0\,\%$ of it is lost in power lines and transformers, so the house's electricity meter receives the fraction $0.950 \cdot 0.400 = 0.380$ of the energy of the fuel. The house has an air-source heat pump with a coefficient of performance of 3.00. How much fuel energy does heating with the pump require at the power plant? Give your answer in kilowatt-hours. Compare the result directly with electric heating and an oil boiler (efficiency 0.900) and conclude which way saves the most fuel.

A city needs electricity of $100\,\text{MW}$ and district heating of $200\,\text{MW}$. Option A: the electricity is produced in a condensing power plant with an efficiency of 0.400 and the heat in a heating boiler with an efficiency of 0.900. Option B: the electricity and heat are produced in a combined heat and power plant with an electrical efficiency of 0.320 and a district heating power equal to 0.560 times the fuel power. The heat of the plant is not enough for the whole district heating need, so the missing part is produced in a similar heating boiler as in option A. All the numbers are example data.

a) Calculate the total fuel power of option A.

b) Calculate the total fuel power of option B.

c) By how much is the fuel power smaller in option B than in option A? Justify where the saving comes from.

In part c), enter the difference of the fuel powers in the answer box in megawatts.

The thermal power of the reactor of a nuclear power plant is $2700\,\text{MW}$ and the electric power $900\,\text{MW}$. The flow of sea water cooling the condenser is a constant $38.0\,\text{t/s}$. The temperatures of the water entering and leaving the condenser have been measured in four months (table, example data). The specific heat capacity of water is $4190\,\text{J/(kg}\cdot\text{K)}$.

a) Calculate the rise in the temperature of the water $\Delta T$ in each month and its average $\Delta T_\text{avg}$.

b) Calculate the heat power $P_\text{L}$ transferred to the condenser, using the average $\Delta T_\text{avg}$.

c) Compare the result with the waste heat power of the plant $P_\text{h} = P_0 - P_\text{s}$. Where does the rest of the waste heat go?

d) Why can the heat of the condenser that warms the sea water no longer be used to produce electricity, and what effect does the heat have on the nearby water in July?

In part b), enter the result in the answer box in megawatts.
